Tune every species and stage the evidence can speak to, in one run

Source: R/tune_run.R
knw_tune_run.Rd

For each species in species and each stage in stages: the scoring population is cut, the rule grid built around link's own thresholds, every rule scored on held-out groups (knw_tune_score()), and the curve fitted at the pick (knw_tune_curve()).

Usage

knw_tune_run(
  visits,
  species_tbl,
  walks,
  thresholds,
  species = knw_species(),
  stages = c("rear", "spawn"),
  spawner = NULL,
  edge_stream = c(1000L, 1100L, 2000L, 2300L),
  area_range = c(10, 10000),
  seed = 54L,
  folds = 5L,
  n_boot = 200L,
  seeds_more = 55:58,
  workers = 1L,
  d_floor = 200,
  min_wsg = 5L,
  power_wsg = 10L,
  src = "pick",
  grid_args = list(),
  cache_dir = NULL,
  thresholds_extra = NULL,
  previous = NULL,
  smoke = TRUE,
  smoke_only = FALSE,
  smoke_args = list(),
  extra = TRUE,
  fit = c("fe", "dense"),
  prior_sd = 2.5,
  evidence_id = NULL
)

Arguments

visits

the build's visits_link table.

species_tbl

the build's visits_species table.

walks

the build's walks, as knw_link_walks() returns them.

thresholds

link's parameters_habitat_thresholds.csv.

species, stages

which to run.

spawner

NULL, or knw_spawner_evidence()'s table.

edge_stream, area_range

the population's constants.

seed, folds, n_boot, seeds_more, workers, d_floor, fit, prior_sd

passed to knw_tune_score() (and fit and prior_sd to knw_tune_smoke(), prior_sd to knw_tune_curve()).

min_wsg, power_wsg

integer(1) the floors described above.

src

character(1) the flow source the exception reads.

grid_args

list of arguments passed to knw_tune_grid() for every species × stage (for example list(grid_grad = c(0.03, 0.09, 0.15))); empty for its defaults.

cache_dir

NULL, or a directory where each species × stage's scored grid is saved as <sp>_<stage>_score.rds and read back on a rerun when the population has the same number of visits and the grid the same rows, in the same order (every knw_tune_grid() column, so a moved default counts), and the settings the score was made with match (fit, prior_sd, seed, folds, d_floor and extra, recorded as spec by knw_tune_score()); a cache written before the record is read back with a message naming the settings it is taken as. n_boot, seed_boot and seeds_more are not checked: a cache's bootstrap and extra-seed tables are read back whatever the run asked for, so give a run with different ones its own directory.

thresholds_extra

NULL, or another bundle's parameters_habitat_thresholds.csv (link's default_tuned): each species' row joins its grid as the is_link_tuned candidate (knw_tune_grid()).

previous

NULL, or a named character vector of the previous pick's rule string per "<sp>_<stage>", which the smoke run scores where present.

smoke

logical(1) run the smoke run and its checks first.

smoke_only

logical(1) return after the smoke run, scoring nothing.

smoke_args

list of arguments passed to knw_tune_smoke() (tol_null, coef_max).

extra

logical(1) passed to knw_tune_score(): the bootstrap, the nested selection and the extra fold seeds. FALSE is the development setting, which proves a scorer change on every species in a fraction of the time; a run that publishes keeps TRUE.

evidence_id

NULL, or character(1) naming the evidence build the visits and walks came from (scripts/0320 passes the md5s of the three derived tables). It joins the cache's settings, so a score made on another build of the same visit count is not read back as this one's.

Value

A list with one element per species × stage ("<sp>_<stage>"): a list with species_code, stage, response, status (fitted, underpowered, no_stream_rule, no_response, too_few_groups, curve_failed; smoke with smoke_only), population, and when scored smoke (knw_tune_smoke()'s result, with smoke), score (knw_tune_score()'s result), pick (the recommended rule row) and curve (knw_tune_curve()'s; NULL with curve_error when its fit failed); null_heldout (the held-out deviance with no rule over the grid's visits), null_heldout_curve (the same model scored over the curve's own visits, those with a size, a gradient and a distance, on the same folds) and grade_withheld, TRUE when the curve's held-out deviance is no better than null_heldout_curve: a curve that predicts held-out groups no better than knowing nothing ranks segments no better either, so its grades are withheld. The comparison is over one population because a width rule's curve fits fewer visits than the grid (unmeasured streams have no width), and each visit it drops would otherwise leave only its own side.

Details

The population follows scripts/0297: visits on the stream branch (FWA edge types edge_stream, not in a river polygon, a wetland of at least 1 ha or a lake of at least 100 ha), with a fished area in area_range, in groups where link's presence rule marks the species present, with no code blocking the species' absence, and no natural barrier to the species downstream before observation overrides (barrier_dnstr_<sp> is FALSE). Rearing's response is detection (U, the species caught); spawning's is spawner evidence (S) from spawner, which the export carries for char only, so a species × stage with no response, no stream rule in default, or fewer than min_wsg groups with both outcomes gets a one-row record saying so and is not fitted. A species × stage with fewer than power_wsg groups is fitted and labelled underpowered.

Before any grid is scored, every species × stage that would be fitted gets the smoke run (knw_tune_smoke(); #84): a handful of rules on the main fold seed, and four checks on the scorer. One failed check on any key stops the run, with every key's report printed, so a scorer defect costs minutes, not the hours of the full grid. smoke_only = TRUE returns after the smoke run (each record carries smoke, and none is scored), which is how scripts/0320 writes the reports before it decides to score.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
thr <- read.csv("parameters_habitat_thresholds.csv")
out <- knw_tune_run(visits, species_tbl, walks, thr, species = c("CH", "BT"), workers = 6)
out$CH_rear$pick
} # }
